settings.heading: The right yak chew for your Dachshund.
settings.subheading: Dachshunds are surprisingly persistent chewers for their size. Their long bodies and small frames need a chew sized for safety — not too large to handle, not too small to swallow.
settings.estimate_note: Standard Dachshunds (16–32 lbs) do well with Small. Miniature Dachshunds (under 11 lbs) need the smallest available size with close supervision.
settings.card_1_text: Standard Dachshunds (16–32 lbs) should use Small. Miniature Dachshunds (under 11 lbs) need close supervision with the smallest size. Their small mouths mean chews last a long time.
settings.card_2_text: Dachshunds are prone to IVDD (back problems). A yak chew keeps them lying down and calm — much better than running, jumping, or playing tug which stresses their spine.
settings.card_3_text: Dachshunds are methodical gnawers with small jaws. A Small yak chew can last 1–3 hours across multiple sessions. This makes them excellent value for small breed owners.
